changeHypothesis.summary: AI inference efficiency improvements did not remove the need for large-scale AI infrastructure. Hyperscaler capex and NVIDIA demand remained strong through the cutoff, implying continued demand for high-bandwidth data-center interconnects rather than a collapse in optical-module demand.
valueChain: high-speed optical-module revenue and product mix
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Meta and Microsoft had already committed large 2025 infrastructure budgets, while NVIDIA reported record data-center revenue and strong Blackwell demand. Large infrastructure programs and network upgrades have multi-quarter deployment lags.
disconfirmingEvidence: Sell-side coverage already expected very high 2025 earnings growth for optical-module leaders, so the industry growth narrative itself was not hidden.
A March market view cited weaker near-term 1.6T deployment and rack-delivery timing as reasons to reduce expectations for some suppliers.
Inference architectures may reduce GPU or optical intensity per unit of workload over time.

evidenceLedger.title: Comment on DeepSeek/NVIDIA demand
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Community signal argued DeepSeek usage overload was consistent with very strong AI demand and constrained NVIDIA supply.

evidenceLedger.title: Comment on DeepSeek R1 analysis

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: NVIDIA reported Q4 revenue of $39.3B (+78% YoY), Data Center revenue of $35.6B (+93% YoY), and described Blackwell demand as strong.

causalChain.mechanism: Large cloud providers publicly maintained or increased AI/cloud infrastructure budgets despite the DeepSeek efficiency shock.
causalChain.failureMode: Efficiency gains reduce aggregate compute spend faster than demand expands.

causalChain.to: larger GPU clusters and network fabrics
causalChain.mechanism: AI infrastructure spend includes servers/GPUs and network infrastructure needed to scale data-center clusters.
causalChain.failureMode: Spend shifts away from accelerator/network hardware or deployment is delayed.

causalChain.from: larger GPU clusters and network fabrics
causalChain.mechanism: Scaling cluster bandwidth increases demand for 400G/800G/1.6T optical interconnects.
causalChain.failureMode: Architecture shifts reduce pluggable optical intensity or competing interconnect technology wins.

causalChain.mechanism: Verified optical-module suppliers can gain revenue and margin from higher volumes and richer high-speed product mix.
causalChain.failureMode: Price competition, yield issues, customer concentration or rapid technology transition compress margins.

losers: legacy low-speed optical products if mix shifts rapidly
substitutes: CPO/LPO architectures that may change module BOM and supplier economics
falseThemeMatches: companies labeled AI or optical without verified hyperscaler/data-center high-speed product exposure

aShareCandidates.name: 中际旭创
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: 2024H1 company disclosure shows high-speed optical modules are core business and demand is tied to cloud/data-center capex and 400G/800G upgrades.

earningsSensitivity.base: Pre-cutoff research already embedded strong growth; no additional numerical alpha assumption is imposed.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: 800G/1.6T deployment and hyperscaler capex persist above market assumptions, lifting high-end volume and product mix.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: 1.6T deployment delays, lower optical intensity, customer capex cuts or price competition reduce growth.

aShareCandidates.name: 新易盛
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Company filings verify data-center high-speed optical-module exposure and 800G/1.6T product capability; 2024Q3 financial growth shows the exposure is economically material.

earningsSensitivity.base: Sell-side already forecast 2025 net profit +96.8%, so ordinary high growth is not an expectation gap.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: Demand persistence and product-mix/overseas-share gains exceed the already-high forecast while valuation remains modest.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: The aggressive earnings forecast proves too high because of competition, new technology, inventory or customer timing.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The market was already explicitly bullish on high-speed optical modules. A 2025-03-18 report forecast 新易盛 2025 net profit of about 57.08亿元 (+96.82%) at ~11.88x 2025E PE. A 2025-03-06 strategy report rated 中际旭创 Buy with a 186元 target versus 105.23元 reference price and ~21.9x 2025E PE.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The differentiated claim is not that AI optical demand exists; it is that post-DeepSeek demand persistence and networking intensity can remain stronger/longer than the market's near-term deployment concerns imply, leaving room for earnings and/or multiple realization.
expectations.measurableGap: Growth recognition is high, but valuation and target-price evidence indicate the market did not price a fully saturated outcome. This is a magnitude/persistence thesis, not a discovery-of-theme thesis.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: Pre-cutoff research placed 新易盛 around 11.88x 2025E PE and 中际旭创 around 21.9x 2025E PE. These are reference valuations from dated research, not outcome-price data.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: partially_priced: industry growth was consensus, but the combination of very strong capex/demand signals and still-moderate forward valuation leaves a testable persistence/magnitude gap.
constraints: Exact 2025-03-31 close and next executable open are intentionally not fetched until the memo is locked.
Daily execution checks will be performed only after freeze.

bearCase: The market already knew the optical-module boom and correctly discounted future normalization. DeepSeek-style efficiency gains, slower 1.6T deployments or CPO/AEC architecture changes could reduce incremental pluggable-module demand, while sell-side growth forecasts were already aggressive.

invalidationConditions.indicator: Major hyperscalers cut or materially defer AI/cloud infrastructure capex relative to January-March guidance.
invalidationConditions.threshold: broad multi-customer capex reduction or deployment delay inconsistent with the frozen demand-persistence thesis

invalidationConditions.indicator: High-speed optical-module demand fails to translate into supplier revenue/margin progression.
invalidationConditions.threshold: material miss versus pre-cutoff growth expectations attributable to weaker high-speed demand/mix rather than unrelated one-offs

unknowns: Exact optical content per GPU/rack architecture
true consensus distribution beyond cited reports
